title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ‘Integrated development-humanitarian programme: Climate-proofing agricultural, energy, and food security practices in Luuq, Belet Xawa, Dollow, Garbaharey, and El Wak counties, Gedo region’ programme, implemented by Trócaire, aims to contribute to Outcome 3.1: Women and older adolescent girls experience increased safety, psychosocial wellbeing, and meaningful participation and leadership. The activities and objective include, access to referral, service providers have knowledge on survivor centred principles, specialised SGBV response and clinical management is provided and communities sensitised, so GBV survivors are able to access / be referred to appropriate services. ---- The principal focus of this objective is:- Women’s protection and access to specialised GBVsupports- Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boys- Support to women’s equality organisations and institutions
